From the kitchen

Photos from the tavern’s own Google listing.

Two cows above the door

Moo Moo Tavern stands on Nissi Avenue 27 in Ayia Napa, under two life-size cows on the roof and a hand-painted arch. In the tavern’s own words: Cyprus traditional food and grill house. The kitchen does grills, souvlaki, steaks, pizza, pasta and seafood. On Google, guests mention the pizza, the welcoming staff, the steak and the meze most often.

Open every day from noon until eleven at night.

What guests say

Two of 1,383 Google reviews, 4.6 stars on average.
